title: Welcome
content:
# Welcome to your offline wiki

This wiki runs **entirely in your browser**. No server, internet connection, or database needed.

## Start here

- Choose **+** on the left to add a page.
- Use **+ Child page** to create a page underneath another page.
- Switch between **Edit**, **Preview**, and **Split** views.
- Search titles, tags, and page content from the left sidebar.
- Use `[[Page title]]` to link one wiki page to another.
- Choose **Save changes** to write each page as its own JSON file.

## Example links

Visit [[Editing guide]], [[Tables, symbols and icons]], or [[Project notes]].

| View | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| Preview | The formatted page |
| Edit | The Markdown source |
| Split | Source and preview side by side |
